description: INGRID is the 1024x1024 HAWAII near-infrared camera for 0.8-2.5 micron imaging on the William Herschel Telescope (WHT).
facility_description: The William Herschel Telescope (WHT) is a 4.2-meter optical/near-infrared telescope at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory on La Palma, operated by the Isaac Newton Group of Telescopes (ING).
notes: INGRID filter-only scans; warm laboratory measurements and cold estimates remain distinct named variants. The ING filter pages (www.ing.iac.es) did not respond during verification, so no links are kept. DetectorType photon, DetectorTypeSource inferred (2026-10-26): no owner states the integration convention for the curve file, but the ING files are filter %T scans ('Filter Brg Temp=77K', https://www.ing.iac.es/Astronomy/instruments/ingrid_new/filter/brg.cold.trans.html), and INGRID 'uses a 1k x 1k HAWAII detector' (https://www.ing.iac.es/Astronomy/instruments/ingrid_new/), so the curves integrate as photon counters. The source is 'inferred' because this rests on the published curve content and the documented detector, not on an explicit owner statement.
